question: What happens to the enjoyer when the enjoyable powers dissolve into him?
premises: Will and the rest are the enjoyable and, for that reason, function as his powers.
If the enjoyable dissolves into the enjoyer, the duality collapses.
In that dissolution, the enjoyer becomes clearly manifest in reality.
inference: When the powers as objects are reabsorbed into the subject, the enjoyer shines forth in his true nature.
plain_english: Will and the rest are only the enjoyable, and for that reason they are his powers; if the enjoyable dissolves into the enjoyer, then the enjoyer becomes clearly manifest in his true reality.
